description: DERIVES the convention-D interface factor 12 that the prior probe only localised. The colour-weighted inter-nucleon crossing sigma - h*(1/2 - delta/4) has exact coefficient with denominator integer content 12 and numerator content 1, so nothing cancels; 12 = 4*3 is the colour-averaging quarter times delta's own third. The prefactor is the PRODUCT of per-crossing denominator contents, 2^(#averaged) * 12, verified on all six atoms. The colour-blind coefficient -h/2 has denominator 2, so the uniform 6 is exactly 12/2 -- the ratio of the two conventions' interface denominators. TRAP: atom_braid_word_3A labels that crossing with a ~60-dps FLOAT (5/12), so denominator content read off the WORD is 1 and the model appears to fail; the float is a template label and crossing_from_cd substitutes the exact form. Take the coefficient from d_for_ctype, never from the word. Scope-(a): these six configurations under bring_color_weighted.

convention.anchor: NONE enters: every measured number is an integer content of an exact rational function of symbolic q. Top-level q0Anchor/q0Value are the ambient WitnessBuilder stamp.

assertions.name: interface_denominator_is_twelve
assertions.note: 12 = 4*3, the colour-averaging quarter in delta/4 times delta's own third: 1/2 - X/(3*4) = (6 - X)/12

assertions.name: interface_numerator_content_is_one
assertions.note: nothing cancels the 12 -- this is what makes the denominator survive into the prefactor

assertions.name: uniform_six_is_the_denominator_ratio
assertions.note: 12/2 = 6: the uniform 6 is the ratio of the two conventions' interface denominators

assertions.name: product_model_holds_on_all_six
assertions.note: prefactor = 2^(#averaged) * den_content(d_iface); A=1 has no interface and gets 2^(2A) with no 12, as an arithmetic consequence rather than a measurement
